items.statement: Ni vacancies are lower-formation-energy defects than Al vacancies in the reported bulk beta-NiAl calculation.
items.expected: The submission states Ni < Al and supports it with the two energies and their difference.

items.statement: The vacancy-energy ordering is mechanistic support for preferential Ni defect formation, not by itself a complete proof of surface segregation kinetics.
items.expected: Interpretation is explicitly bounded to bulk defect energetics and acknowledges missing kinetic/surface proof.
